verses.1: Unto the end. A Psalm for the sons of Korah.
verses.2: All nations, clap your hands. Shout joyfully to God with a voice of exultation.
verses.3: For the Lord is exalted and terrible: a great King over all the earth.
verses.4: He has subjected the peoples to us and subdued the nations under our feet.
verses.5: He has chosen us for his inheritance: the splendor of Jacob, whom he has loved.
verses.6: God ascends with jubilation, and the Lord with the voice of the trumpet.
verses.7: Sing psalms to our God, sing psalms. Sing psalms to our King, sing psalms.
verses.8: For God is the King of all the earth. Sing psalms wisely.
verses.9: God will reign over the peoples. God sits upon his holy throne.
verses.10: The leaders of the peoples have been gathered together by the God of Abraham. For the strong gods of the earth have been exceedingly exalted. [ Psalm 47 ] (48)
